title: QUIC RFC 9000 STREAM Frame Focused Proof Verification
verification_method: Focused S19P8 requirement-home tests, supporting stream parser/fuzz tests, Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, and SpecTrace JSON validation.
scope: This verification covers focused STREAM frame parser, formatter, maximum-offset, and receive-state error-policy proof for the listed S19P8 requirements.
expected_result: S19P8 requirement-home tests prove OFF/LEN/FIN bit handling, type value bounds, varint fields, declared-length behavior, packet-remainder consumption when LEN is clear, maximum stream offset handling, invalid local/send-only stream receipt rejection, and receive credit excess classification.
procedure: Run the focused S19P8 requirement-home filter.
Run the supporting stream parser/fuzz filter.
preconditions: Existing STREAM parser and formatter remain the canonical stream-frame wire-format seam.
Existing connection stream state remains the canonical receive-state policy seam.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim closure of other S19 frame families, public stream APIs, or packet-level close emission behavior for every parser failure.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-04. The focused S19P8 filter passed 79/79 before canonical xref cleanup; final generated triage, Release build, and SpecTrace JSON validation are recorded by this verification run. On 2026-05-22, the RFC9000 topoff filter for REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-0021, 0028, 0280, and 0282 passed 8/8; REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-0021 is bounded to single STREAM-frame open/data/close receive-state proof.
